title: Help on the zero-site home keeps the guide facts of earlier answers and always carries the add-site article, so it stops retracting what it said
steps: S1: run apps/tracy-web/test/assistant.test.mjs: the system prompt on the zero-site home, for a lone question and for a follow-up after an earlier question.
expect: S1: the Add site article is in the prompt on every zero-site turn; an article an earlier question brought in is still in the prompt for the follow-up; the start screen Help offers no Add site link.
fence: Prompt assembly is checked, not what a model answers

tests: Help prompt: on the zero-site home the Add site article rides in full on every turn
Help prompt: an article an earlier question brought in stays for the follow-up
